2609.17010.title: ThinkFlow: Self-Evolving Probabilistic Latent Memory for Lifelong Conversational Agents
2609.17010.paper_summary: Lifelong conversational agents rely on memory systems to maintain deep, context-aware interactions with users. However, existing explicit textual memory pipelines suffer from a severe information bottleneck, often losing subtle behavioral patterns and emotional shifts. Furthermore, being typically static post-deployment, they cannot autonomously adapt to personal habits and preferences without manual feedback. Cognitive science, however, suggests that humans maintain mental models purely in a latent space and continuously refine them through predictive coding. Inspired by this, we propose \textbf{ThinkFlow}, a novel end-to-end latent memory framework for lifelong conversational agents. ThinkFlow bypasses the text bottleneck by dynamically compressing conversational flows into probabilistic latent memory skills, autonomously consolidating complex user states into disentangled, continuous vectors without semantic interference. To break this barrier, we introduce a test-time evolution paradigm. By coupling teacher-guided latent alignment to bootstrap the initial state with a self-supervised next-user-utterance prediction task for continuous refinement, the framework successfully overcomes cold-start challenges and achieves label-free lifelong personalization. Extensive experiments on long-term conversation benchmarks demonstrate that ThinkFlow significantly outperforms prevailing memory systems, providing highly personalized and contextually accurate responses over extended multi-session interactions.
2609.17010.paper_summary_zh: 終身對話代理依賴記憶系統來維持與用戶之間深度、具上下文意識的互動。然後，現有的明確文本記憶管道遭遇嚴重的信息瓶頸，常常會遺失微妙的行為模式和情感變化。此外，因為通常在部署後是靜態的，它們無法在沒有手動反饋的情況下自動適應個人習慣和偏好。然而，認知科學表明，人類在潛在空間中維持心理模型，並通過預測編碼不斷完善它們。受到此啟發，我們提出了\textbf{ThinkFlow}，一種新穎的端到端潛在記憶框架，用於終身對話代理。ThinkFlow通過動態壓縮對話流程為概率潛在記憶技能，繞過文本瓶頸，自動將複雜的用戶狀態整合為解耦的連續向量，且不會產生語義干擾。為了打破這一障礙，我們引入了一種測試時演化範式。通過將教師引導的潛在對齊與自我監督的下一用戶發話預測任務結合，以啟動初始狀態並進行持續的完善，該框架成功克服了冷啟動挑戰，實現了無標籤的終身個性化。在長期對話基準上的大量實驗顯示，ThinkFlow顯著優於現有的記憶系統，在延長的多會話互動中提供高度個性化和上下文準確的回應。
